title: COMEX gold drawdown and realised volatility

methodology.drawdown: 100 * (close / maximum of trailing 252 valid closes including today - 1). Null until 252 closes. This is distance below trailing high, not window maximum drawdown.
methodology.volatility: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of trailing 20 daily log returns * sqrt(252) * 100. Requires 21 closes.
methodology.missing: No interpolation; windows count valid trading observations.
methodology.contract: GC=F unadjusted continuous close includes contract rolls; measures quoted-price risk, not a fixed-expiry strategy return.
